opennyai_summary.3_August_2023__facts: The applicant has been convicted by the appellate Court for an offence punishable under Section 16(i)(a)(i) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for six months with fine of Rs.1,000/-, with default stipulation.
opennyai_summary.3_August_2023__arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the trial Court has n o t properly appreciated the oral and documentary evidence available on record.
opennyai_summary.3_August_2023__decision:
The maximum jail sentence awarded to the applicant is six months.
The applicant is in custody and disposal of this revision will take considerable time, therefore, the jail sentence of the applicant may be suspended and he may be released on bail.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the application.
The applicant has prayed for suspension of sentence mainly on the ground that the provision of section 13(2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act was violated but in this case the applicant was convicted by the courts below for mis-branding of food items and not for selling or keeping in possession the adulterated food items.
The application for suspension of sentence is accordingly dismissed.

opennyai_summary.final__facts:
The applicant has been convicted by the appellate Court for an offence punishable under Section 16(i)(a)(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for6 months with fine of Rs.1000/-, with default stipulation.
The maximum jail sentence awarded to the applicant is six months.
opennyai_summary.final__arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the trial Court has n o t properly appreciated the oral and documentary evidence available on record.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
The disposal of this revision will take considerable time, therefore, the jail sentence of the applicant may be suspended and he may be released on bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, this application is allowed subject to depositing fine amount, if not already deposited, and on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned, the custodial sentence of the applicant shall remain suspended and he shall be released on bail for securing his presence before the trial Court concerned on 06.11.2023 and on such other dates as may be fixed in this regard.
The applicant shall regularly appear before the trial Court during the pendency of this revision without fail.
I.A. No.19765/2023 is, accordingly, allowed and disposed of.
List the case for final hearing in due course.
opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS:
The appellant was convicted for mis-branding under Section 7(ii)/16(1)(a)(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act which is an offence punishable with a maximum term of three years' imprisonment.
Looking to the fact that the sample of food item was taken in the year 2006 and the report of public analyst was received in 2007 but the complaint was filed in the year 2011, this second application for suspension of sentence is allowed for the reason that this ground was not raised in the earlier application.
